Name: Tan Dog
Author: 3gg3
Description:
This mod adjusts the coloration of the vanilla dog to make it less saturated.  The result is a dog whose coat color appears more natural.

To use this mod, download the .zip file, unzip the file using your program of choice, copy the file to [i]Stardew Valley > Content > Animals[/i], and overwrite the original file.  Making a backup of the original file is recommended. 



This mod is my first mod that I have ever created.  I am using it as practice to understand modding Stardew Valley before taking up a more ambitious project.
